meta.name: add-anydoc
meta.description: Add local office-document-to-Markdown conversion to NanoClaw agent containers with the pinned Firecrawl AnyDoc CLI. Use when agents need to read attached Word, PowerPoint, Excel, OpenDocument, RTF, EPUB, CSV, or text-based PDF files without uploading them to a hosted parser.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让你的智能助手直接读懂本地各类办公文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的智能助手需要读取本地办公文档却不便上传到云端
copy.tagline_en: Let your AI agent read local office documents directly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your AI agent to read local office docs without uploading them.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能在本地把附带的办公文档（Word、PPT、Excel 等）转成 Markdown，保存在 /workspace/agent/converted/，并只总结相关章节；图片型 PDF 会明确报错，不会上传到外部解析器。
howto.when: 当 agent 需要读取 Word、PowerPoint、Excel 等办公文档附件，且希望在本机转换而不是上传到托管解析器时触发。

say.text: 把这份 Word 转成 Markdown，并总结要点。
这个 Excel 附件转成 Markdown，告诉我数据概况。
say.note: 表格 Markdown 不代表计算结果

say.text: 帮我看下这个 PDF 是不是扫描件，转成 Markdown。
say.note: 图片型 PDF 会明确失败

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can convert attached office documents (Word, PPT, Excel, etc.) to Markdown locally, save them to /workspace/agent/converted/, and summarize only relevant sections. Image-only PDFs fail clearly and are never uploaded.
howto.when_en: Triggered when an agent needs to read attached office documents such as Word, PowerPoint, Excel, etc. and wants local conversion instead of a hosted parser.

say_en.text: Convert this Word document to Markdown and summarize the key points.
Convert this Excel attachment to Markdown and give me an overview of the data.
say_en.note: Spreadsheet Markdown is not authoritative for calculations

say_en.text: Check if this PDF is a scan and convert it to Markdown.
